definitions.explanation: A facility where convicted criminals are confined as punishment. A somewhat formal or literary word for prison.

examples.japanese: {監獄|かんごく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れられた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十年間|じゅうねんかん}{監獄|かんごく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: The criminal spent ten years in prison.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{監獄|かんごく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The old prison is open to the public as a history museum.

notes:
{監獄|かんごく} is a somewhat formal or literary term for prison. In everyday speech, ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧ is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {監獄|かんごく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in prison
- {監獄|かんごく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to be released from prison
- {監獄|かんごく}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: prison life
- {監獄|かんごく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{収容|しゅうよう}→収容：11800_shuuyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confine in prison

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧: prison (standard everyday term)
- ⟦{牢屋|ろうや}→牢屋：15832_rouya⟧: jail, dungeon (old-fashioned, dramatic)
- ⟦{拘置所|こうちしょ}→拘置所：30455_kouchisho⟧: detention center (pre-trial)

REGISTER:
Often appears in historical contexts, fiction, and news about prison conditions. Has a heavier, more dramatic tone than ⟦{刑務所|けいむしょ}→刑務所：19074_keimusho⟧. The Japan {監獄法|かんごくほう} (Prison Act) was renamed in 2006.
